title: tiny.london
author: Boris Starkov
description: All of Greater London as one isometric pixel-art map, drawn by a fine-tuned image model from Google's 3D map.

title: Isometric NYC
author: Andy Coenen
description: New York in the style of SimCity 2000, drawn tile by tile by a fine-tuned image model. The map that started the rest.

title: Isometric Istanbul
author: Yahya Bedirhan Pak
description: Both sides of the Bosphorus, from the city's own 3D model, redrawn by a fine-tuned Qwen model following the tiny.london method.

title: Pixel Berlin
author: Rupert Hoffschmidt-McDonnell
description: All of Berlin as one muted isometric map, redrawn from Google's 3D map by a Qwen LoRA, with address search.

title: Isometric Warsaw
author: Bedirhan Yildirim
description: The whole of Warsaw in pixel art, drawn live in the browser from open data, with trams and trains on their timetables.

title: HypeSeoul
author: bitjaru
description: All of Seoul as one isometric painting by a fine-tuned image model, with day and night on Seoul time and live subway trains.

title: tinygyn
author: Thomas M.
description: Goiânia redrawn as an isometric pixel-art map from the city's 3D model.

title: tinyrj
author: Thomas M.
description: Rio de Janeiro redrawn as an isometric pixel-art map from the city's 3D model, with planes to fly over it.

title: Tiny Stockholm
author: Audrius
description: Stockholm, Solna and Sundbyberg, redrawn with the tiny.london LoRA, with trains, buses and boats on their timetables.

title: tiny detroit
author: Gabriel
description: The whole City of Detroit as one pixel-art map painted by a Qwen LoRA, with the QLine and the People Mover.

title: tiny.blr
author: Rithvik
description: Greater Bengaluru from Google's 3D map, with Namma Metro, wards and weather; the pixel art is still being drawn.

title: SimCABA
author: Nicolás Poore
description: Buenos Aires in the style of SimCity, from more than 12,000 generated pictures.

title: pixis
author: @nfmelendez
description: An arcade flight over an isometric pixel-art Neuquén, taking off from the Monumento a la Bandera.

title: earthToPixels
author: Tiago Trindade
description: João Pessoa in the style of SimCity, from Google's 3D map through a fine-tuned open Qwen model.

title: Isopolis
author: nuwandavek
description: San Francisco as one giant isometric pixel painting by a custom model, with tours and postcards.

title: SimLeón
author: Enrique
description: León, Guanajuato in the style of SimCity 2000, drawn from Google's 3D map in a palette of 256 colours.

title: CDMX Isométrica
description: Mexico City in pixel art, drawn in the browser from OpenStreetMap, from the Centro Histórico to Xochimilco.

title: Tiny Vancouver
description: A sunny pixel-art Vancouver with place labels, evening light and a small flight mode.

title: tiny tashkent
author: Shahzod
description: All of Tashkent as an illustrated isometric map from real streets and buildings, searchable in Latin or Cyrillic.

author: Josh
description: Rotterdam in miniature from the city's 3D model, with sunlight, lit windows at night and the weather now.

title: Abidjan en miniature
author: Opriel
description: Le Plateau drawn building by building from OpenStreetMap and aerial photos, redrawn by Codex, with its towers named.

title: Isometric Málaga
author: Brosax
description: The Mediterranean coast, the cathedral, the port, La Malagueta bullring and Gibralfaro hill, about 2.4 gigapixels of pixel art.

title: Isometric Amsterdam
author: sezer
description: Amsterdam's historic centre with all 68,543 buildings at their real heights, canals, parks and trees; the landmarks are being redrawn one by one from photos.

title: Tiny Warsaw
author: Dominik Roszkowski
description: Warsaw as a low-poly 3D diorama built from OpenStreetMap, GUGiK heights and the city's tree map, with hand-modelled landmarks, live flights at Okęcie, day and night light, rides and multiplayer flying.

title: London, drawn
author: Akash Wadhwani
description: 216 square kilometres of central London redrawn by AI from Google's 3D map, one 700-metre square at a time, with 183 buildings you can open.

title: JF em Pixels
author: Tárcio Zemel
description: Isometric pixel art map of Juiz de Fora with plenty of information and gamification.

title: Tiny Belgrade
author: Tümay Sönmez & Buse Turgay Sönmez
description: Belgrade redrawn tile by tile as one isometric pixel-art map, from Kalemegdan and the old town to New Belgrade and Zemun.

title: Tiny Prague
author: Martin Janoušek
description: Central Prague as a live isometric map from open data, in vector or pixel art, with real roofs from the city's 3D building model.

title: Tiny Prague
author: Aleš Sršeň
description: All of Prague as a stylized isometric map, redrawn from Google Earth captures by a fine-tuned Qwen model, with place search and metro and tram overlays.

title: tiny frankfurt
author: amm98d
description: Frankfurt as an isometric pixel-art map, redrawn from Google's 3D map with a Qwen image model, with street life on the river and roads. Starting with the skyline, the Altstadt and Sachsenhausen.

title: Tiny Prague
author: Tomáš Kapler
description: All of Prague as a real-time low-poly 3D city from open map, terrain and aerial data, with hand-modelled landmarks, live trams, buses and metro, planes, day and night and a route planner.

title: Isometric Toronto
author: John Fewell
description: Downtown Toronto from Bathurst to the Don and Bloor to the harbour as one isometric illustration after SimCity 2000, drawn by a small model that learned from a big one's examples.

title: TinySP
author: Lucas Guerras
description: São Paulo redrawn as an isometric pixel-art map, with day and night tiles.

title: Isometric Vancouver
author: Daniel
description: Central Vancouver as one illustration about 4.4 km across, from Stanley Park to Kitsilano, redrawn tile by tile by GPT Image from Google's 3D tiles.

title: Tiny Toronto
author: Ricky Zhang
description: Toronto from the lake north as an illustrated, zoomable map, redrawn tile by tile by image models, with the whole Greater Toronto Area still to come.

title: Tiny Toronto
author: Ahmed Nadar
description: A painted Toronto where every building is real: point at one to see what it is. Downtown and the Shops at Don Mills so far, with weather, day and night, and raccoons to find.

title: Isometric SF
author: Justin Chavez
description: The entire San Francisco Bay Area, over 1,300 square miles, as one pixel-art map painted by a 4B-parameter image model, with place search and views to send.

title: Tiny Barcelona
author: brunoqgalvao
description: Barcelona drawn as a game map, from Montjuïc to the Sagrada Família and the port, with landmark pins and a small flight mode.

title: brasilia.isocity
author: Igor Azevedo & Breno Kern
description: Niemeyer's modernist capital rebuilt as a tiny pixel-art city, made fully locally, with place search.

title: Isometric Los Angeles
author: William Gibson
description: Every street from the Valley to the harbor as one giant isometric image, made with tiny.london's method on Andy Coenen's isometric-nyc viewer, with place search.

title: Tiny Madrid
author: Shinferencia
description: An illustrated isometric map of Madrid built from the city's municipal 3D mesh, with a Windows 98-style interface, driving, flying and street races.

title: Tiny Tirana
author: Okan Erturan
description: The whole city, the airport and Mount Dajti as one isometric pixel-art map, made in about a day with Claude Opus 5.5 and a LoRA trained on Colab for seamless tiles, with buses on the real timetable, live planes, the Dajti cable car and 46 landmark cards.

title: Isometric State College
author: Pranav Karra
description: State College and Penn State's campus in the style of SimCity 2000, painted from Google's 3D map by a fine-tuned image model in seven seasons and times of day.

title: Tiny Rome
author: Dr Ozgur Kesici
description: Rome 8 km around the centre, redrawn by Qwen-Image from Google's 3D model as one inked, hand-coloured picture, with a history mode that plays 2,700 years where it happened.

title: Isometric Seattle
author: Dylan Martin
description: Central Seattle, about 5.7 miles across, from Ballard and the University of Washington to the stadiums and the port, traced tile by tile by GPT Image from Google's 3D map.

title: TinyLyon
author: Anir
description: Lyon's nine arrondissements and Villeurbanne as a pixel-art map, with trams, landmark pins and modes to drive, fly or race.

title: Isometric Kinderdijk
author: sezer
description: All nineteen Kinderdijk windmills, rendered from real 3D building data and Dutch topography and redrawn as pixel art with Grok Imagine, with their stories, real photos and a windmill game.

title: Leuven Social
author: basteau
description: Leuven's historic centre inside the ring road as a tiny pixel-art 3D city from open data, to walk or cycle round, or ride off on a bike from a rack.

title: Isometric Cities: Montreal
author: sam10155
description: Griffintown and Old Montreal as one pixel-art map generated from Google's 3D map, after isometric.nyc.

title: Isometric Cities: Ottawa
author: sam10155
description: Parliament Hill and central Ottawa along the river as a pixel-art sample generated from Google's 3D map, after isometric.nyc.

title: Isometric Cities: Victoria
author: sam10155
description: The Inner Harbour and the BC Legislature as a pixel-art sample generated from Google's 3D map, after isometric.nyc.

title: Isometric Mumbai
author: Aryan Gupta
description: All of Greater Mumbai, about 560 km² from Colaba to Dahisar, as one pixel-art map with taxis, BEST buses and local trains, from a 3D city its maker built first, as Google's mesh of Mumbai is flat.

title: Isometric Luxembourg
author: Amirhossein Daraee
description: Central Luxembourg City as an inked, painted illustration that follows the real clock, with trams and trains on today's timetable and 47 landmark cards; the rest of the city is still to be painted.

title: Kraków w pikselach
author: Michał Pietralik
description: All of Kraków as a 3D pixel-art map with a timeline of 16 eras from 965 to today, trams on the real timetable and windows that light up at night.

title: Isometric Kraków
author: Sergio Carcamo
description: The whole of Kraków drawn live in the browser from open data, from Wawel and the Main Market Square to Kazimierz, by day, at dusk, at night or under snow, with trams running.

title: tiny lisbon
author: Fernando Amaral
description: Lisbon from Belém to Parque das Nações as one zoomable pixel-art map, drawn by Gemini from Google's 3D map.

title: Pixel Singapore
author: Yadong Xie
description: Central Singapore, about 8 by 6 km round Marina Bay, as an AI-drawn pixel map with traffic, birds and swaying trees, and a switch between 2016 and 2026.

title: Tiny València
author: Miguel Beltrán Sanz
description: The whole municipality of València, from the huerta to the Albufera, painted block by block as one isometric pixel-art map.

title: ICanSee.MK
description: Districts of Milton Keynes as isometric maps, each painted from Google's 3D map by a different AI image model, so you can switch between their styles.

title: Tiny Brussels
description: The EU quarter round Schuman as a living miniature from the region's open 3D data, with the weather and time of day as they are now, trams and the Sunday market.

title: Tiny Orindiúva
author: Mateus Freitas
description: A small town in São Paulo state as a toy-like isometric city from OpenStreetMap streets and 2,316 real building outlines, with the local weather.

title: Isometric Bielsko-Biała
author: Marek Wajdzik
description: The whole city as pixel art rendered live in the browser from open data and lidar, with the real sun, four seasons, buses at their live positions and trains on the timetable.

title: Iso Cincy
description: Greater Cincinnati's 34,000 buildings in 3D in the style of a city-building game, following the real time of day, the weather and the level of the Ohio River.

title: Saigon Rush Hour
author: 0xabys
description: District 1 at rush hour as an isometric 3D traffic simulator on the real street map, with motorbikes, cars and buses.

title: Pixel Hyderabad
author: nutanc
description: Hyderabad from HITEC City to the Old City, about 18 by 11 km, as isometric pixel art rendered from OpenStreetMap and elevation data.

title: Isometric Albuquerque
author: Jon Hebert
description: The Albuquerque metro from the Sandia crest to the West Mesa volcanoes, rendered from OpenStreetMap and elevation data, with an overlay of parishes, Mass times, trails and public land.

title: Walk North Campus
author: Brendan Sudol
description: The University of Georgia's North Campus as a walkable isometric map, built from OpenStreetMap with Kenney's free game art.

title: Petit Paris
description: All of Paris inside the périphérique as a procedural 3D map of 128,000 real buildings from the city's open data, to explore, search by address or cross by plane or car.

title: Tiny Montréal
author: Rafael Casagrande
description: Montreal from Verdun to Rosemont as one miniature, built from OpenStreetMap and the city's 3D buildings, rendered in Blender and painted tile by tile by a small style LoRA, with live weather, seasons and night.

title: Tiny Venezia
author: Max Rohowsky
description: Venice round San Marco, the Rialto and the Salute as a painted isometric map with moving water, illustrated with Google Gemini from OpenStreetMap data.

title: Tiny Floripa
description: The centre of Florianópolis, Beira-Mar Norte and the bridges as pixel art, generated in 87 sectors from real building outlines and the city's aerial photos; the rest of the city is still to be drawn.

title: Isometric World: Tel Aviv-Yafo
author: Dmytro Krasun
description: Tel Aviv-Yafo's 36,604 buildings and 230,452 trees from the city's open data, built into a 3D model and painted in one style with GPT Image.

title: Isometric Milwaukee
author: Tarik Moody
description: Downtown Milwaukee from the Art Museum to the Domes as one illustration, painted tile by tile by an image model from Google's 3D map, with landmark cards and a daily history hunt.

title: tiny pyongyang
author: Shahzod
description: Central Pyongyang and the districts round it on both banks of the Taedong as pixel art from OpenStreetMap's streets and buildings, following the city's real time of day, weather and season.

title: Paris en pixels
author: Louis-Marie Soulard
description: Paris inside the ring road in isometric pixel art, with day, night, rain and traffic, drawn procedurally from IGN open data.

title: tiny.ottawa
author: Michael Sun
description: Central Ottawa and the Gatineau core as one illustrated isometric map, painted by a Qwen model from Google's 3D map, with place search and weather to switch.

title: Tiny Curitiba
author: Andre Vogellmann & LuizPVDK
description: All of Curitiba as one miniature, painted by a Qwen model from Google's 3D map, with capybaras by the lake in Parque Barigui and a bi-articulated bus calling at its tube station.

title: Tiny Copenhagen
author: donlion
description: Copenhagen, Frederiksberg and all of Amager as one pixel-art map, drawn in code from OpenStreetMap with roof and tree colours from aerial photos, no image model.
